 Carlisle, PA 17013

  Scope:
 
Description of Project:
 The Project consists of selective demolition of a portion of the existing Mooreland Elementary School and construction of additions and selective alterations to Mooreland Elementary School, including new parking areas, driveways and outdoor play areas.  Generally, the new construction consists of load bearing masonry, steel joists and metal deck, masonry veneer, exterior metal wall panels, EPDM membrane roofing, aluminum storefront systems, casework and interior finishes along with the specified mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems.

 Dresher, PA 19025

---------------------

  Scope:
 Project Description: The New Jarrettown Elementary School project involves the construction of a new two-story, 88,000 gross-square-foot educational facility for the Upper Dublin School District.  The new building features concrete foundations, structural steel framing, slab-on-grade construction, masonry interior/exterior walls, complete MEP and fire protection systems, and commercial food service equipment. Executed under a multi-phase contract schedule, the scope encompasses building the new facility (Phase 1 substantial completion targeted for June 2029), followed by the complete abatement and demolition of the existing school facility, and final site redevelopment incorporating paved access drives, parking areas, and stormwater management systems through early 2030.

L.J. Paolella Construction
 INVITATION TO BID
 New Jarrettown Elementary School
 
 Bids are due by: November 30, 2026 1:00 PM
 

---------------------

 You have been invited to bid on this project. Will you be bidding?

---------------------

 To: Partition Plus Inc
 
 Attn: Estimating 
 
 , 
 

---------------------

 Project: New Jarrettown Elementary School
 Address: 1520 Limekiln Pike
 Dresher, PA 19025
  Bid Due: November 30, 2026 1:00 PM
 

---------------------

  Scope:
 
Upper Dublin School District is building a new two-story, 87,930 SF elementary school. The school will be built on the site of the existing school, which stays occupied during construction. Once the new building is turned over, the existing school will be abated by a separate contractor and then demolished. Final site work follows the demolition. Electrical, HVAC and Plumbing/Fire Protection are separate prime contracts.
 
General Construction scope (Divisions 02–14, 31, 32, 33)
 
 Demolition: the existing school after abatement, plus site demolition
 Sitework: E&S controls, clearing, mass earthwork, rock and unsuitable soil removal per unit prices, dewatering, and grading on about 8.4 acres. 
 Site utilities: water, fire service, sanitary, storm, the stormwater basin and its liner. All stop 5 ft outside the building.
 Paving and site improvements: paving, curbs, walks, 105 parking spaces, fencing, retaining walls, two ball fields, landscaping, and playground surfacing and base
 Structure: concrete foundations and slabs, structural steel, joists, deck, metal stairs and railings
 Masonry and envelope:
 
 Masonry and brick veneer
 Cold-formed framing and sheathing
 Air barrier and insulation
 Composite metal panels
 Storefront, curtain wall and glazing
 
 
 Roofing: EPDM and metal roofing, including all flashing at MEP penetrations and curbs
 Interiors:
 
 Doors, frames and hardware
 Drywall and ACT
 Terrazzo, tile, resilient and resinous flooring, carpet tile, and wood athletic flooring
 Paint and wall coverings
 
 
 Specialties and equipment:
 
 Specialties, including the operable partition
 Food service equipment, stage curtains and gym equipment
 Casework and window shades
 Hydraulic elevator
 
 
 
  Plans:
 OPR
  Other Info:
 
 
 MilestoneDate
 
 
 
 
 
 Notice to Proceed (anticipated)
 
 
 
 
 February 2027
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Building Substantial Completion
 
 
 
 
 June 21, 2029
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Existing school demolition
 
 
 
 
 Summer–Fall 2029
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Site Substantial Completion
 
 
 
 
 February 27, 2030
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Final Completion
 
 
 
 
 March 27, 2030

BuildingConnected Josh Cooney of Bracy Construction, Inc. sent your company a message about Exeter Township Emergency Services Building: Toilet Partitions ----------------------------------------------- Addendum #6 Posted ------------ Hi All, Please see the attached addendum #6 released by the design team this morning. It contains clarifications to RFI 239 ONLY. 239.) QUESTION: Please issue or confirm a responsibility matrix for the A106 equipment list showing, for each EQ item, who furnishes, who installs, and who provides power, water, gas, blocking and anchorage. Specifically: (1) EQ46 Heavy Duty Motorized Chain Winch (Allied Power Products HD series): 01 1200 Sec 1.10.A.39 -40 have the GC install Owner -furnished motorized chain winches. Please confirm the winch is Owner furnished and GC installed, who provides its power and control wiring, and the weight and load so the W8x18 hoist beam on the structural framing plan and its attachment can be confirmed; (2) the A106 comments that say 'Prime 1A contractor to provide blocking in wall': there is no Prime 1A in 01 1200. Please identify the contract (General Construction, BP-02, is assumed); (3) EQ2 and EQ7 lockers/turnout gear storage and EQ26, EQ27 and EQ39 plastic lockers: confirm which are GC furnish and install; (4) EQ14 -EQ22 fitness equipment, EQ28 and EQ35 compressors, EQ30, EQ32 and EQ34 hose and cord reels: confirm anchorage and blocking responsibility; (5) confirm EQ13, EQ18, EQ20, EQ29, EQ31, EQ44 and EQ47 are deleted. RESPONSE: 1. EQ46 will be Contractor furnished, see updated section 01 1200. Power and control wiring by EC. 2. A106 has been revised to state GENERAL CONTRACTOR instead of 1A Prime. 3. General Contractor to furnish and install. A106 updated. GC to furnish and install EQ26, EQ27 and EQ39 plastic lockers. Turnout gear lockers EQ2 and EQ7, their power bar accessory, and their support tube steel (EQ2 only) shall be provided by Owner but fully assembled and installed by the GC. Good afternoon,
Keller Brothers is bidding the VIEW Transition Academy renovation and addition
for Loudoun County Public Schools (IFB #26-548, 24328 Marrwood Dr, Aldie, VA).
We would like your price for the attached scope of work.
Sub bids are due to Keller by November 16th @ COB. The GC bid is due to LCPS on
11/17/2026 at 2:00 PM, so we need your number on time to carry it.
When you submit your price, please:
1. Fill out the Bid Form in Section 13 of the scope, including every breakout,
alternate, separate price and unit price listed.
2. Acknowledge Addenda 1 through 4. Addendum 5 is expected by 11/13. We will
forward it as soon as it is issued, and your price must include it.
3. List any exclusions or qualifications clearly. Anything not listed as
excluded will be treated as included in the scope.
4. Include your bond rate, if applicable, and confirm you can meet the schedule.
Substantial Completion is 5/1/2028 and Final Completion is 6/1/2028.
A few project notes:
- The project is not prevailing wage, and the contract has no escalation clause,
so carry your own escalation.
- The existing building will be vacant at Notice to Proceed.
- The project is pursuing LEED v4 Silver. Please include the LEED submittals
required by your specification sections.
Please reply to confirm whether you will be bidding. Thank you, and we look
forward to your proposal.
Thank you,
Michaela Mehaffie
Keller Brothers

top_message:
Hello,


RFI responses have been uploaded to the folder Please review and revise
your proposal to reflect them. Bids are due *tomorrow *11/10.

-------


CK Commercial invites you to provide a proposal for *Howard County Board of
Elections*. Please confirm your intent as soon as possible.


*SITE VISIT: October 28, 2026 at 9:30 am November 3, 2026 at 9:30*


   - *Please arrive at least 5 minutes prior *
   - *Sam is the point of contact*
      - *Please call me if you have any questions.*

*RFIs:  October 29, 2026 by 5:00pm*


   - *All questions should be submitted in writing to CK Commercial. Please
   refrain from addressing client directly with questions*

*BIDS DUE: November 10, 2026 by 5:00pm*


   - Please submit proposals to: *APRIL*@ck-commercial.com
   <APRIL@ck-commercial.com>, *CJ*@ck-commercial.com <CJ@ck-commercial.com>,
   SAM@ck-commercial.com

*PROJECT ADDRESS:* *7138 Columbia Gateway Drive, Columbia, MD, 21046*



*PROJECT DOCUMENTS
<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/124nE8iz2z1ljRzwWoGXF1rhELtZQNSkS?usp=sharing>*
 *[ <<< CLICK HERE ]*

****Subcontractors are responsible for reviewing all documents, not only a
single discipline, for completeness of scope and requirements.

   - COPT Defense Leak Detection Standards
   - Photos 10.28
   - Copy of Howard County Board of Elections_Bid RFI Log_11-09-26_CDP
   Responses
   - Drawings
      - Individual Sheets
      - HCBE_7138 CGD_Bid Package
      - 20261009_7138CGD_HCBE_CD_100%_Combined

*SCOPE:*


   - *Carpet, LVT, VCT, Vinyl Wall base, and Flooring are to be installed
   and Furnished by COPT*
   - *GC *
      - *Demo existing floors*
      - *Floor prep*
      - *Ceramic Tile*
      - *Ceramic Tile Base*
      - *Other items not listed in COPT *
   - Do not combine divisions (e.g., drywall & painting, plumbing & HVAC,
   electric & tele-data, etc.)
   - *BUILDING REQUIRED VENDORS:*
      - *Roofing prefered:* FA Taylor & Son
         - 410-477-5330
         - admin@fataylorson.com
      - *HVAC Controls:* Smart Building Technologies
         - GC to hold contract
      - *Fire Alarm:* BFPE
   - *DECK HEIGHT:* +/- 13'- 0"
   - *DEMOLITION: *
      - MEPs to cut / cap / drop to floor for demolition subcontractor to
      haul off.
      - Demolition subcontractor to install temporary protection material
      (masonite on floors & correx on walls) furnished by CK along the access
      path from building delivery entry.
   - *ALTERNATES: *
      1. *No additional work required*
         - *Furnish and install millwork as indicated by Keynote 11 on
         IA-111 and on Elevation 6B/IA502.*
      2. *No additional work required*
         - *Furnish and install millwork as indicated by keynote 12 on
         IA-111 and on elevation 4B/IA402*
      3. *No additional work required*
         - *Furnish and install sink and faucet as indicated by keynote 13
         on IA-111. Refer to engineering drawings for additional information.*
      4. *No additional work required*
         - *Furnish and install lower base cabinets as indicated by keynote
         13 on IA-112 and on elevation 6E/IA-402*


*SCHEDULE:*


   - *START (Est): *
      - *NTP: *Late November, 2026
      - *Construction Start: *December 1, 2027
   - *COMPLETION (Est): April 1, 2027*
   - *WORKING HOURS:* 6:00 am - 2:30 pm, loud work before 8:00 am.
   - Provide lead times and any expediting options
   - Provide anticipated duration for your scope of work


*SAFETY, INSURANCE, TERMS:*

   - *SAFETY:*
      - Click Here for CK Safety Requirements
      <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uRIzBKg8eygOm4jvGdWuhPiV4MCoZpI5?usp=sharing>
      - Effective October 1, 2025, all ladders being used and delivered to
      any CK project site are to be Type 1A, Fiberglass.
      - Effective October 1, 2025, all subs on any CK project site will be
      required to wear the Type 2, Class C vented safety helmet with
chin straps
      with an attached safety visor or safety glasses on your person
at all times.
   - *INSURANCE: *
      - Click Here for CK Insurance Requirements & Sample COI
      <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_uILO-IZxkQG5h7AJTnCwbabE3uCYsrA?usp=sharing>
   - *MASTER SUBCONTRACT AGREEMENT:*
      - All awarded subcontractors will be required to execute a MSA as
      part of the contract award unless there is an executed MSA
already on file.
      - Click Here for CK Master Subcontract Agreement
      <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13n2t7SOM1OwaPbKTSoCOcGyNbPcxdRtr?usp=sharing>
      - CK requires labor rates to be incorporated into the subcontract
      agreement.
      - CK requires the change order markup rate to be incorporated into
      the subcontract agreement.
   - *BUILDING RULES & REGULATIONS:*
      - Subcontractors must adhere to all client / building rules &
      regulations


Thank you,
Sam Minnerly
